title: Egyptian decoration at the Mount Wilson lodges

tellings.quote: The lodges where astronomers stayed were reportedly decorated with Egyptian hieroglyphs and symbols

plain: The lodges where astronomers stayed at Mount Wilson Observatory, above Pasadena, California, were "reportedly decorated with Egyptian hieroglyphs and symbols." Michels tells it as something reported, linking it to the astronomer George Ellery Hale, in an episode about hidden pagan and ritual threads running through American space science.
